title: Golden Energy Boy
description: A sequence of four painted panels showing a young blond boy in a black and gold mechanical suit. From left to right: he stands with roots at his feet emitting golden bubbles from his hands, runs forward with energy trails, punches with a massive yellow energy explosion, and stands with smoke rising as golden orbs float around him.
prompt: A four-panel sequence showing the same young blond boy wearing a black and gold armored suit with glowing yellow accents. In the first panel he stands emitting golden energy bubbles from his hands with roots at his feet. Second panel shows him running forward with motion trails and energy effects. Third panel features a powerful forward punch creating a massive bright yellow starburst explosion with flying particles. Final panel shows him standing with smoke rising and golden bubbles floating around him. Dramatic lighting, cinematic action style, painted on dark background.
